summary: Rex Cheatham is a Democratic legislative candidate for Alabama House District 8 who ran in the 2014 election. He recorded an out-of-fold Campaign Model Outcome (CMO) score of approximately +16.7 against Republican incumbent Terri Collins, with adjusted scores remaining positive after accounting for spending and fundraising differences. His public identity was centered on education-labor alignment rather than cultural issues.
offices_and_public_service: Former teacher in Morgan County schools
Worked for the Alabama Education Association (AEA)
Education liaison to Governor George Wallace
community_and_local_ties: Leadership of the Morgan County Democratic Executive Committee
Democratic national and state delegate (repeated service)
